definitions.R: K_R[e,f] = A_line[e,f] / deg_line(e), zero diagonal, row sum 1, no self loops
definitions.U: K_U[e,f] = 1/(n_bonds-1) for e != f, n_bonds=1 -> zero, row sum 1, no self loops
definitions.pair_convention: unordered e<f with both row weights stored (w_src for row e, w_dst for row f)

checks_note: R and U store different pair lists (R: line-graph edges only, U: all e<f), so the pair-MLP FLOPs differ; row sums and total mass match exactly on every molecule with n_bonds >= 2.  R==U only when the line graph is complete (always at n_bonds=2).
